context.transcript:
Welcome to our 25th Annual Software Development Conference.
We have an exciting agenda prepared for you, including three keynote speeches.
Our first speaker, Rodrigo Flores, is the creator of the mobile phone application PocketMe, which currently has over a million users, and... it was launched six months ago.
You can find where he'll be giving his speech in our online program.
Remember that for the first time, this year the conference is paper-free.
Use any of the QR codes available to access the schedule.
context.transcript_translation:
欢迎参加我们第25届年度软件开发大会。
我们为您准备了激动人心的议程，包括三个主题演讲。
我们的第一位演讲者 Rodrigo Flores 是移动电话应用程序 PocketMe 的创建者，该应用目前拥有超过一百万用户，并且……它是在六个月前推出的。
您可以在我们的在线节目中找到他发表演讲的地点。
请记住，今年首次，本次大会是无纸化的。
使用任何可用的二维码来查阅日程。
